provenance.giver: English Wiktionary (given-name entries, wikitext), the diminutive-of rows extracted from the `dimof=` argument or the entry's free text, each quoted verbatim as its witness
provenance.rule: kept only when both ends are Russian lemma nodes the givers write as a name; otherwise a typed gap with the quoted witness; a variant base is a second row; a chain is separate rows with no stored closure
provenance.not_claimed: that a row is a true relation beyond what the giver wrote; reverse (base to diminutive) lookups; kinship
